$comment: Golden response-shape contract for the vin_pairing feature. Each named field MUST appear as a literal in the firmware source that builds the cJSON response (verified by eval.sh).

required_fields_in_data.ok: bool — true on success, false on failure
required_fields_in_data.message: string — human-readable success summary (present iff ok=true)
required_fields_in_data.error: string — failure reason from vin_pairing_run_now (present iff ok=false)

fields.boxcode: string — only present when connected; from connection_manager_get_boxcode()
